text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":3000,"unit":"dollars","kind":"money","span":"buys a bedroom set for $3000"},{"id":"q2","value":1000,"unit":"dollars","kind":"money","span":"sells his old bedroom for $1000"},{"id":"q3","value":10,"unit":"percent","kind":"count","span":"pay 10% a month"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"remaining amount owed after selling the old bedroom set"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"relates the remaining balance to the 10 percent monthly rate (symbolic; the monthly payment is 10% of s1, not a literal multiplication by 10)"}],"target":{"kind":"money","scope":"how much Tom has to pay per month (10% of the remaining balance owed)"},"dismissed":[]}
